## CuratedNullabilityEvidenceSchema variable

Evidence a manifest author supplies: a note naming why the claim holds (an app guarantee, a structural invariant, documentation, or a test), and, on a resource with a single instance, the reads in which the app reported no value (`absentReads`<!-- -->).

**Signature:**

```typescript
CuratedNullabilityEvidenceSchema: z.ZodObject<
  {
    source: z.ZodLiteral<'curated'>
    note: z.ZodString
    observedAt: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodISODateTime>
    appVersion: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodString>
    absentReads: z.ZodOptional<
      z.ZodObject<
        {
          observedAt: z.ZodISODateTime
          bundleId: z.ZodString
          appVersion: z.ZodString
          osVersion: z.ZodString
          failedReads: z.ZodNumber
          errorNumbers: z.ZodArray<z.ZodNumber>
          reason: z.ZodString
        },
        z.core.$strict
      >
    >
  },
  z.core.$strip
>
```
